title: Surgical supply price check
description: Fetch cited public product pages and emit plausible USD unit prices.

items.title: Items to check
items.description: Items default to the two cited product URLs. The backend may also send item ids as strings; supported ids with a cited default URL are resolved automatically.

css_selector.description: Optional CSS selector for the displayed price.

regex.description: Optional regular expression applied to page text; capture the price in group 1 when possible.

unitsPerPack.description: Set explicitly when the listed price is for a multi-unit pack; the actor divides pack price by this count.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Fetch and parse pages, but do not push dataset rows. Preview successful rows in OUTPUT.
